structured.answer: If I must pick, I lean to Harel's "כספי (שקלי)" track (קופה 13254), because Harel is a name I know and it shows 0% shares and 0% foreign currency, with 4.25% over 3 years and a 0.57% fee. But I'm not sure it beats my deposit, so I'll ask my son or the bank before I do anything.
